Area on the saved evaluation domain where relative solution error ≤ 0.1, estimated with trapezoid-weighted grid samples. Failed predictions count as outside tolerance.
Trapezoid-weighted grid area meeting relative error ≤ 0.1 outside the training disk or segment. This measures area, while directional reach measures contiguous accuracy from the patch center.
Analytic solution error on the actual training equations after the fixed iteration budget; this is not the optimization loss. It reveals poor fitting before interpreting outside-patch error.
Median first-failure radius minus the patch radius (segment half-length for center). Negative margins indicate failure within that extent. Capped rays are shown in the directional reach figures.
